groups.selectionNote: 要强调“放进去”用 insert；强调“插电或堵洞”用 plug。plug it in 中代词放在动词与 in 之间。

entries.definitionEn: To put something inside or between other things.
entries.scenario: 强调把东西放进内部或间隙

examples.en: Insert the card into the slot.

entries.definitionEn: To connect a device to a socket, or fill a hole.
entries.scenario: 强调接通设备，或封住孔洞

examples.en: Plug the cable into the socket.

groups.selectionNote: 只是说价格高用 expensive；高到使人放弃用 prohibitive。后者不是单纯更高级的 expensive，而是多了一层阻碍行动的含义。

entries.definitionEn: Costing a lot of money.
entries.scenario: 价格高，未必高到无法接受

examples.en: This watch is expensive.

entries.definitionEn: So expensive that it prevents people from buying or doing something.
entries.scenario: 费用成为购买或行动的障碍

examples.en: The cost of repairs was prohibitive.

groups.selectionNote: 规则扣分、处罚或制度让人吃亏时优先考虑 penalize；一般惩罚用 punish。两者都常接 for 表示处罚原因。

entries.definitionEn: To impose a penalty or put someone at a disadvantage.
entries.scenario: 按规则扣分、处罚，或使处于不利地位

examples.en: They penalized him for arriving late.
examples.zh: 他们因他迟到而处罚他。

entries.definitionEn: To make someone suffer a penalty for doing something wrong.
entries.scenario: 对错误或不当行为施加惩罚，范围更广

examples.en: He was punished for cheating.

groups.selectionNote: 手机掉落、价格下跌用 drop；水龙头持续滴水用 drip。a drop of water 是一滴水；a drip 可指滴落声或滴漏。

entries.definitionEn: To fall, let something fall, or decrease in amount; a small amount of liquid.
entries.scenario: 可指一次掉落，也可指数量减少

examples.en: I dropped my phone.

entries.definitionEn: To fall or flow in small, separate drops.
entries.scenario: 突出液体一滴一滴地流出

examples.en: Water dripped from the ceiling.

groups.selectionNote: 问“赚了多少”常用 profit；借贷产生的利息用 interest；广义好处用 benefit。benefit sb 是使某人受益，benefit from 是从某事中受益。

entries.definitionEn: Money left after costs are paid; to gain an advantage.
entries.scenario: 商业中常指收入扣去成本后的余额

examples.en: The shop made a profit.

entries.definitionEn: Money paid for borrowing or saving money; a desire to know more.
entries.scenario: 金融中是借贷资金的费用或收益；也指兴趣

examples.en: The bank pays interest on savings.

entries.definitionEn: An advantage or helpful effect; to help or gain from something.
entries.scenario: 对健康、学习、生活等产生的正面作用

examples.en: Exercise benefits your health.

groups.selectionNote: 快速转动常用 spin，围绕中心运行常用 revolve，绕轴转动或轮换常用 rotate；这些用法有重叠。wheel 作名词是“轮子”，作动词则常描写推着轮式物体移动（wheel a suitcase），或盘旋、转身（birds wheel overhead / wheel around）。The wheel spins 是“轮子快速旋转”，第一个 wheel 是名词；不能把动词 wheel 机械替换成所有“自转”的说法。 revolve 也能描述绕轴自转，如 a revolving door；“revolve 只指公转、rotate 只指自转”不是普遍规则。

entries.definitionEn: To turn around quickly; also to make thread or present a particular version of events.
entries.scenario: 突出快速转动；也可指纺纱或编造说法

examples.en: The wheel was spinning fast.

entries.definitionEn: To turn around a central point or axis; to have something as the main focus.
entries.scenario: 可绕中心运行，也可绕自身轴转动；并非只表示公转

examples.en: The discussion revolves around costs.

entries.definitionEn: To turn around an axis or take turns in a regular order.
entries.scenario: 绕轴转动或按顺序轮换，不必很快

examples.en: Rotate the image clockwise.

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 车轮；推着轮式物体移动；盘旋转向
entries.definitionEn: A circular part that turns on an axle; to move something on wheels, or turn and move in a curve or circle.
entries.scenario: 名词指轮子；动词可指推着有轮子的物体走，或人、鸟等转身、盘旋移动，强调运动路径而非单纯绕轴自转

examples.en: Birds wheeled above the cliffs.

groups.selectionNote: vapor 范围比 steam 广。严格说可见白雾由细小水滴构成，但日常说 steam rose from the kettle 很自然；科学语境要分清物态。

entries.definitionEn: The gas form of a substance that can also be liquid or solid.
entries.scenario: 物质处于气态的形式，不限于水；英式 vapour

examples.en: Water vapor is invisible.

entries.definitionEn: Water in its gas form, also used for the visible mist above hot water; to cook with steam.
entries.scenario: 特指水的蒸气；日常也称可见白雾为 steam

examples.en: Steam the vegetables for five minutes.

groups.selectionNote: 一个讨论要点是 point；支撑结论的理由可以是 argument；组织并展开论证的过程是 argumentation。argument 不一定是争吵，需看搭配。

entries.definitionEn: Reasons supporting an opinion, or an angry disagreement.
entries.scenario: 可以是一套理由，也可以是人与人争执

examples.en: Her argument is supported by evidence.

entries.definitionEn: A particular idea, opinion, or important detail in a discussion.
entries.scenario: 讨论中的一个具体想法，不一定包含完整论证

examples.en: You made a good point.
examples.zh: 你提出了一个很好的观点。

entries.definitionEn: The process of developing and presenting reasons for a position.
entries.scenario: 正式、学术用语，强调组织理由的方式

examples.en: The essay lacks clear argumentation.
examples.zh: 这篇文章缺少清晰的论证。

groups.selectionNote: disorder 可指无序状态、疾病或功能障碍；disturbance 可指打扰事件，也可指功能或状态的紊乱，如 sleep disturbance。不能硬分成“长期状态”和“一次事件”。

entries.definitionEn: A lack of order, or a condition affecting normal functioning.
entries.scenario: 状态或某类功能异常，不必是一次事件

examples.en: The papers were in disorder.

entries.definitionEn: Something that interrupts peace, order, or normal activity.
entries.scenario: 原有平静或正常活动受到扰动

examples.en: The noise caused a disturbance.

groups.selectionNote: 惊讶地脱口而出用 exclaim；提高音量用 shout/yell。shout at 常有对人怒喊的意味，shout to 常为让远处的人听见，但仍需看上下文。

entries.definitionEn: To speak suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion.
entries.scenario: 强调情绪引发的突然表达，未必持续大喊

examples.en: “What a view!” she exclaimed.

entries.definitionEn: To make a loud cry or speak very loudly.
entries.scenario: 常带强烈情绪，也可为让远处的人听见

examples.en: He yelled for help.

entries.definitionEn: To speak or call out in a loud voice.
entries.scenario: 提高音量，可传递信息、呼救或争吵

examples.en: She shouted to us across the river.

groups.selectionNote: 这两个词不是近义词。要找录音文字稿或成绩记录选 transcript；要描述“另一地区的同职人员或同类事物”选 counterpart。

entries.definitionEn: A written record of speech, or an official record of academic results.
entries.scenario: 语音的文字记录，或课程成绩记录

examples.en: I read the interview transcript.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing with a similar role in another place or situation.
entries.scenario: 在另一个组织或场景中承担相似职能者

examples.en: She met her French counterpart.
examples.zh: 她会见了法国的同职同行。

groups.selectionNote: 打印机卡纸、交通拥堵常用 jam；道路、入口或视线被挡住常用 block。The door is jammed 侧重门卡死，The door is blocked 侧重门口被堵。

entries.definitionEn: To become stuck or crowded so that movement is difficult.
entries.scenario: 突出物品挤在一起或机器无法运转

examples.en: The paper jammed in the printer.

entries.definitionEn: To prevent movement, access, or progress by putting something in the way.
entries.scenario: 挡住通道、视线、进入或进展

examples.en: A fallen tree blocked the road.

groups.selectionNote: 任命人到职位用 appoint；安排会议、交通和活动用 arrange。arrange for sb to do 很常见；不要把“预约”机械译为 appoint a meeting。

entries.definitionEn: To officially choose someone for a role or set a time or place.
entries.scenario: 赋予职位，或正式确定时间地点

examples.en: They appointed her as director.

entries.definitionEn: To plan something or put things in a particular order.
entries.scenario: 组织活动或把东西按顺序摆放

examples.en: We arranged for a taxi to collect her.
examples.zh: 我们安排出租车去接她。

groups.selectionNote: smell 可作名词也可作动词；odor 通常只作名词。感官系动词 smell 后常接形容词：smell good，而不是用 well 表示“闻起来很好”。

entries.definitionEn: To notice an odor with your nose; an odor itself.
entries.scenario: 通用词，可作感官动词，气味可好可坏

examples.en: The bread smells wonderful.

entries.definitionEn: A particular smell, often a strong or unpleasant one.
entries.scenario: 较正式，常见于描述强烈或不悦气味；英式 odour

examples.en: There was a strange odor in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里有股奇怪的气味。

groups.selectionNote: 专业研究机构常叫 institute，但应尊重机构正式名称。institution 可描述银行、学校等组织，也能描述婚姻等制度，不能只理解为一个建筑。

entries.definitionEn: An organization for specialized work or study; to introduce a system or practice.
entries.scenario: 名词常指专业研究教育机构；动词指建立或开始实施

examples.en: They instituted new safety checks.
examples.zh: 他们实行了新的安全检查。

entries.definitionEn: An established organization, social system, or custom.
entries.scenario: 范围广，既可指组织，也可指长期社会制度

examples.en: Marriage is a social institution.

groups.selectionNote: 两词没有可靠的“理论与实践”二分。日常描述分析能力常用 analytical skills；学科术语按固定搭配记忆，两者许多场景可互换。

entries.definitionEn: Using analysis; often used in technical or academic terms.
entries.scenario: 常见于学科术语，与 analytical 有大量重叠

examples.en: She studies analytic philosophy.

entries.meaningZh: adj. 分析的；善于分析的
entries.definitionEn: Examining things carefully by considering their parts and relationships.
entries.scenario: 常形容思维、技能、方法和人

examples.en: The task requires analytical skills.
examples.zh: 这项任务需要分析能力。

groups.selectionNote: 说“抱歉打扰”常用 intrude；军事入侵常用 invade。intrude on someone's privacy 与 invade someone's privacy 都成立，但前者有 on，后者直接接宾语。

entries.definitionEn: To enter or interfere where you are not welcome or invited.
entries.scenario: 未经邀请介入他人的时间、空间或事务

examples.en: I don't want to intrude on your privacy.

entries.definitionEn: To enter by force or spread into a place in large numbers.
entries.scenario: 更有强势进入或大量涌入的意味

examples.en: Tourists invaded the quiet village.
examples.zh: 游客大量涌入这个安静的村庄。

groups.selectionNote: paw 是整只爪掌，claw 是尖爪；可以说 a paw with sharp claws。鸟类和蟹类通常不会把相应结构都称为 paw。

entries.definitionEn: The foot of an animal such as a cat or dog; to touch or scratch with it.
entries.scenario: 猫狗等动物的整只爪掌，不只是尖端

examples.en: The dog put a paw on my knee.
examples.zh: 狗把一只爪掌放在我的膝上。

entries.definitionEn: A sharp, curved animal nail or a pincer; to scratch or grip with claws.
entries.scenario: 指尖锐弯曲的爪，也可指蟹等的螯

examples.en: The cat scratched me with its claws.

groups.selectionNote: comment 作动词常用 comment on sth，也可接 that 从句或直接引语：She commented that the room was cold. commentary 常指解说或较连贯的评论；不是简单按评论长短划分。

entries.definitionEn: An opinion or remark; to express an opinion about something.
entries.scenario: 一条意见，或发表意见的动作

examples.en: She commented on my report.
examples.zh: 她对我的报告发表了意见。

entries.definitionEn: A spoken or written explanation or discussion of events.
entries.scenario: 连贯的赛事解说、解释或系统评论

examples.en: We listened to the live commentary.

groups.selectionNote: 不要硬按材质软硬区分：test tube 也是硬的。试管、牙膏管等记 tube；供水、燃气管道常用 pipe，具体行业命名会有重叠。

entries.definitionEn: A hollow cylinder or a container shaped like one.
entries.scenario: 可指试管、软膏管等多种管状物

examples.en: She bought a tube of toothpaste.

entries.definitionEn: A tube used to carry liquid or gas; to transport something through pipes.
entries.scenario: 常用于输送气体或液体，也可指烟斗

examples.en: Water flows through the pipe.

groups.selectionNote: 两词的行李义通常不可数：说 much luggage 或 two pieces of baggage，不说 two luggages。baggage 的抽象“情感包袱”义更常见。

entries.definitionEn: Bags and cases used when travelling.
entries.scenario: 出行时携带的箱包，常见于一般旅行语境

examples.en: We have three pieces of luggage.

entries.definitionEn: Travel bags and cases; also emotional burdens from past experiences.
entries.scenario: 旅行义与 luggage 重叠，还可指情绪或经历负担

examples.en: He carries a lot of emotional baggage.
examples.zh: 他背负着许多情感包袱。

groups.selectionNote: 想拥有别人已有的东西常用 envious；担心伴侣关系受威胁常用 jealous。但 jealous 也广泛用于羡慕别人，不能硬说它只涉及三个人。

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy about someone else's advantages, or afraid of losing someone's affection.
entries.scenario: 既可嫉妒别人拥有的，也可担心关系被夺走

examples.en: He was jealous of her success.

entries.definitionEn: Wishing you had something that another person has.
entries.scenario: 侧重想拥有别人已有的优点、东西或机会

examples.en: I'm envious of your free time.

groups.selectionNote: 一种具体营养成分是 a nutrient；整体营养状态或营养摄取是 nutrition。形容词 nutritious 表示有营养的，nutritional 表示与营养有关的。

entries.definitionEn: A substance that living things need to grow and stay healthy.
entries.scenario: 具体能提供营养的物质

examples.en: Food supplies essential nutrients.

entries.meaningZh: n. 营养；营养摄取（不可数）
entries.definitionEn: The process of taking in and using food, or the nourishment food provides.
entries.scenario: 整体营养过程、状况或研究领域

examples.en: The course covers basic nutrition.
examples.zh: 这门课涉及基础营养知识。

groups.selectionNote: 头发卷起或身体蜷成一团常用 curl；道路平滑转弯用 curve。curly 是卷曲的，curved 是弯曲的，不是同一种外形。

entries.definitionEn: A curved or spiral shape; to form such a shape.
entries.scenario: 形成卷圈、螺旋或卷起的边缘

examples.en: The edges of the paper curled.

entries.definitionEn: A smoothly bending line or shape; to bend smoothly.
entries.scenario: 平滑地改变方向，不必形成卷圈

examples.en: The path curves around the lake.

groups.selectionNote: 污染现象用 pollution；造成污染的物质用 pollutant。动词为 pollute，过去分词 polluted 常表示已被污染的。

entries.definitionEn: The contamination of the environment by harmful substances or effects.
entries.scenario: 环境被有害物质影响的现象或状态

examples.en: Air pollution has increased.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that causes pollution.
entries.scenario: 造成污染的具体物质或因素

examples.en: The factory releases pollutants.

groups.selectionNote: negative 讨论正负、赞否或影响性质；passive 讨论是否主动。一个人可以态度乐观却行动被动，两者不自动对应。

entries.definitionEn: Expressing refusal, opposition, or an unfavorable view or effect.
entries.scenario: 侧重观点、态度、影响或数值的性质

examples.en: She gave a negative answer.

entries.definitionEn: Accepting what happens without taking an active role.
entries.scenario: 不主动行动、接受外力或安排；也指被动语态

examples.en: He remained a passive observer.
examples.zh: 他一直只是被动的旁观者。

groups.selectionNote: 常规表达用 affect + 宾语，或 have an effect on + 宾语。effect 作动词时是促成变化，不等于简单的“影响”；effect change 是常见搭配。

entries.definitionEn: To influence or change someone or something.
entries.scenario: 直接描述某事改变或影响另一事物

examples.en: Stress affects sleep.

entries.definitionEn: A result or consequence; as a verb, to bring something about.
entries.scenario: 名词强调结果；正式动词强调使变化发生

examples.en: The policy had little effect.

groups.selectionNote: 不强调方式时用 break；打得粉碎用 smash；撞上东西用 crash into；挤压变形用 crush。crash 也可表示电脑崩溃，与实体破碎不同。

entries.definitionEn: To break violently into pieces or hit with great force.
entries.scenario: 力度大，常造成破碎；也可夸张表达打破纪录

examples.en: The ball smashed the window.

entries.definitionEn: To separate into pieces, stop functioning, or interrupt; a short rest.
entries.scenario: 最通用的损坏或断开，不限定方式

examples.en: I broke a cup.

entries.definitionEn: To collide violently or suddenly stop working.
entries.scenario: 车机猛烈撞击，或系统突然失灵

examples.en: The car crashed into a tree.

entries.definitionEn: To press something so hard that it breaks or loses its shape.
entries.scenario: 从外部施压使变形或碎裂

examples.en: Crush the garlic before cooking.

groups.selectionNote: damage 不保证完全毁坏；destroy 通常强调摧毁。ruin 很适合坏掉的体验或前途，wreck 常用于严重毁坏车辆或计划，但这些不是绝对的程度等级。

entries.definitionEn: To damage something severely; something badly damaged or destroyed.
entries.scenario: 常用于车辆、建筑、计划的严重破坏

examples.en: The collision wrecked the car.

entries.definitionEn: To damage something so completely that it cannot be used or restored easily.
entries.scenario: 破坏到无法使用或不复存在

examples.en: The fire destroyed the warehouse.

entries.definitionEn: Harm that reduces value or usefulness; to cause such harm.
entries.scenario: 不一定完全毁坏，程度可轻可重

examples.en: The rain damaged the books.

entries.definitionEn: To spoil something severely; destruction or the remains of a destroyed building.
entries.scenario: 使价值、体验、前途等严重受损

examples.en: The argument ruined the evening.

groups.selectionNote: allege 常提示涉及未获证实的指控；claim 范围更广，且有索取义。这两个动词都不自动证明陈述为真或为假，不能当作真假标签。

entries.definitionEn: To say something is true, especially wrongdoing, without having proved it.
entries.scenario: 常涉及未证实的不当行为，较正式

examples.en: They alleged that the figures were false.
examples.zh: 他们指称这些数字是假的。

entries.definitionEn: To state that something is true or demand something as your right.
entries.scenario: 主张某事为真，也可要求权利或领取物品

examples.en: He claims to know the answer.

groups.selectionNote: 被派去参会的代表是 delegate；机构副手常是 deputy。delegate 作动词时可用 delegate a task to sb，名词与动词的重音/读音也有差异。

entries.definitionEn: A representative; to give someone responsibility or authority to act.
entries.scenario: 名词指代表；动词指把任务或权力交给别人

examples.en: She delegated the task to me.

entries.definitionEn: Someone who assists a leader and can act in their place.
entries.scenario: 职位上的副手或获授权代行职务的人

examples.en: The deputy spoke in her absence.

groups.selectionNote: 一般善意用 kind；在胜负、接待或地位差异下表现礼貌宽厚可用 gracious。gracious 不等于 grateful：后者强调心怀感激。

entries.definitionEn: Polite, kind, and generous, especially toward others in social situations.
entries.scenario: 强调待人有风度，尤其面对输赢或地位差异

examples.en: The winner was gracious to her rivals.
examples.zh: 获胜者对对手很有风度。

entries.definitionEn: Caring about others and wanting to help them.
entries.scenario: 泛指关心他人、愿意帮助，不要求正式礼仪

examples.en: It was kind of you to help.

groups.selectionNote: raise 必须考虑“抬高了什么”；rise 的主语自身上升；arise 常用于问题或机会出现。过去分词依次为 raised、risen、arisen。

entries.definitionEn: To lift something, increase it, or bring a topic to attention.
entries.scenario: 及物：主语使别的东西上升或出现

examples.en: They raised the rent.

entries.definitionEn: To move upward or increase without a direct object.
entries.scenario: 不及物：主语自身上升或增加

examples.en: The rent rose sharply.

entries.definitionEn: To happen, appear, or come into existence.
entries.scenario: 不及物：抽象问题、机会或情况出现

examples.en: New opportunities arose.

groups.selectionNote: 宇宙相关选 cosmic；普遍适用选 universal；天文学相关或数字大得惊人选 astronomical；一般规模或程度巨大选 immense。

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the universe.
entries.scenario: 与整个宇宙有关，也可夸张表示极大

examples.en: Scientists study cosmic rays.

entries.meaningZh: adj. 普遍的；全体适用的
entries.definitionEn: Applying to everyone or everything in a particular scope.
entries.scenario: 强调覆盖所有或广泛群体，不等于体积巨大

examples.en: The rule is not universal.
examples.zh: 这条规则并非普遍适用。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 天文学的；数字巨大的
entries.definitionEn: Relating to astronomy; also extremely large in amount.
entries.scenario: 专业义与天体研究有关，夸张义常修饰费用数字

examples.en: The repairs cost an astronomical sum.
examples.zh: 修理花了一笔天文数字般的钱。

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large in size, amount, or degree.
entries.scenario: 可修饰规模、程度、数量等

examples.en: The discovery is of immense value.

groups.selectionNote: 四词没有固定可量化的大小排序。广袤空间和极广覆盖范围常用 vast；huge 最通用，immense/enormous 常用于加强巨大程度，依搭配选择。

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large in size, amount, or degree.
entries.scenario: 常有令人惊叹的程度或规模感，较书面

examples.en: The project required immense effort.

entries.definitionEn: Very large in size, amount, or degree.
entries.scenario: 日常通用，可指实体、数量或抽象影响

examples.en: There is a huge difference.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large or great.
entries.scenario: 强烈强调超出通常规模，常与 huge 重叠

examples.en: They spent an enormous amount of money.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large in area, extent, or quantity.
entries.scenario: 突出延展范围、面积或数量的庞大

examples.en: The vast majority agreed.

groups.selectionNote: 决心明确用 determined；持续不放弃可用 persistent；克服困难坚持用 persevering；牢牢抓住目标用 tenacious；不肯改变看法常用 stubborn。persistent 不必总是褒义。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 坚韧的；紧抓不放的
entries.definitionEn: Holding firmly to something and refusing to give up.
entries.scenario: 强调牢牢坚持，不轻易放弃目标或观点

examples.en: She is a tenacious researcher.
examples.zh: 她是一位锲而不舍的研究者。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 持续的；坚持不懈的
entries.definitionEn: Continuing for a long time or continuing despite difficulty.
entries.scenario: 重复或持续存在，可褒可贬

examples.en: His persistent questions annoyed me.
examples.zh: 他接连不断的问题让我烦躁。

entries.definitionEn: Continuing to work toward a goal despite difficulties.
entries.scenario: 强调面对困难仍继续努力，通常褒义

examples.en: The persevering student finally succeeded.
examples.zh: 这位坚持不懈的学生终于成功了。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 固执的；难以去除的
entries.definitionEn: Unwilling to change your mind, or difficult to remove or deal with.
entries.scenario: 不肯改变，也可形容顽固污渍或问题

examples.en: The stain is stubborn.

entries.definitionEn: Firmly decided and strongly committed to doing something.
entries.scenario: 目标明确，决意去做

examples.en: She is determined to finish.

groups.selectionNote: 分期款只是 payment 的一种；deposit 和 loan 不相同。instalment/installment 是拼写变体。deposit 的具体返还规则不能仅从这个英文词判断。

entries.definitionEn: One of several payments or parts released over time; British spelling.
entries.scenario: 英式常见拼写，也指分期连载的一部分

examples.en: We paid in monthly instalments.

entries.definitionEn: One of several payments or parts released over time; American spelling.
entries.scenario: 美式常见拼写，与 instalment 同义

examples.en: I paid the final installment.

entries.definitionEn: The act of paying, or an amount of money paid.
entries.scenario: 泛指付款动作或一笔款项

examples.en: Payment is due on Friday.

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 押金；订金；存款；存放
entries.definitionEn: Money paid in advance or as security, or money put into a bank; to put something somewhere.
entries.scenario: 指先付的保证款或存入的钱，具体用途看语境

examples.en: We paid a deposit on the room.

entries.definitionEn: Money or something else borrowed temporarily; to lend.
entries.scenario: 借入后须归还的款项，也可指借出的物品

examples.en: She took out a loan to buy a car.

groups.selectionNote: 泛指朝向用 direction；导航方位可用 bearing。get one's bearings 是熟悉或辨明方位，have a bearing on 却是与某事相关，不能照字面译成方向。

entries.definitionEn: Direction or position, relevance to something, or a person's manner.
entries.scenario: 导航指方位；固定搭配中可指关系或影响

examples.en: The result has a bearing on our decision.
examples.zh: 结果与我们的决定有关。

entries.definitionEn: The way something moves or points; guidance on what to do.
entries.scenario: 泛指朝向；复数常指路线说明或指示

examples.en: We walked in the wrong direction.

groups.selectionNote: adore 适合表达非常喜欢某人或某物；worship 更有敬拜或把人奉若神明的意味。worship 偶像时可为夸张说法，不必真的涉及宗教仪式。

entries.definitionEn: To love or like someone or something very much.
entries.scenario: 对人或物的强烈喜爱，日常可用

examples.en: I adore spending time with them.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢和他们相处。

entries.definitionEn: To show religious devotion or very strong admiration.
entries.scenario: 核心为宗教敬拜，也可夸张表示极度崇拜

examples.en: They worship at the temple.

groups.selectionNote: approximately 与 roughly 作“大约”时常可互换，正式程度不同不等于精确程度固定不同。approximate 是形容词或动词：an approximate number；approximately 是副词：approximately 50 people，不能说 approximate 50 people 来表示“大约50人”。roughly 另有粗略地、粗暴地的意思。

entries.definitionEn: Close to an amount or value, but not exactly.
entries.scenario: 较正式的数值估算，不保证特别精确

examples.en: It costs approximately £50.

entries.meaningZh: adv. 大约；粗略地；粗暴地
entries.definitionEn: Approximately; also without precision or with force.
entries.scenario: 估算义较日常，另可描述不精细或粗暴动作

examples.en: He pushed me roughly.

entries.definitionEn: Close to the actual value but not exact; as a verb, to estimate or come close to something.
entries.scenario: 形容词修饰名词，动词表示接近或估算；不是 approximately 的副词替代形式

examples.en: The approximate cost is £50.

groups.selectionNote: 强调货运模式和运费时用 freight；强调运载的货物时常用 cargo。两词的货物义有重叠，并非一个只能陆运、一个只能海运。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 货物；货运；运费；货运运输
entries.definitionEn: Goods transported in bulk, their transport, or its cost; to transport goods.
entries.scenario: 常强调商业运输体系、方式或费用

examples.en: Freight charges have increased.

entries.definitionEn: Goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.
entries.scenario: 强调正在运输或装载的货物，常见于船机语境

examples.en: The ship carries a cargo of grain.

groups.selectionNote: fireplace 是壁炉或生火取暖的空间；stove 是炉具，可指烹饪炉灶，也可指封闭式取暖炉；furnace 常指工业熔炉或建筑的中央供暖炉。炉灶上做饭用 on the stove；壁炉里生火用 in the fireplace；不能把 furnace 当作普通厨房炉灶。

entries.definitionEn: A space built into a room where a fire can burn, usually connected to a chimney.
entries.scenario: 通常指房间墙内或墙边用于生火取暖的空间，传统壁炉连接烟囱

examples.en: We sat by the fireplace on a cold evening.
examples.zh: 在一个寒冷的晚上，我们坐在壁炉旁。

entries.definitionEn: An appliance used for cooking or heating a room.
entries.scenario: 常用于做饭或局部取暖

examples.en: Put the pan on the stove.

entries.definitionEn: An enclosed structure producing high heat for industry or building heating.
entries.scenario: 常指工业高温处理或建筑供暖设备

examples.en: The metal melted in the furnace.

groups.selectionNote: accurate 侧重正确贴合事实；precise 侧重细节清楚或测量一致。科学测量中的准确度与精密度有专门含义，日常用法则有重叠。

entries.definitionEn: Correct and close to the true facts or value.
entries.scenario: 与事实或真实数值相符

examples.en: The map is accurate.

entries.definitionEn: Exact, detailed, and clearly expressed or measured.
entries.scenario: 日常指准确具体、表达明确；测量语境可指重复结果接近，不应把精密度等同显示小数位数

examples.en: Give me the precise address.

groups.selectionNote: 要表达“论证认为”用 argue that，不要默认翻译成吵架。反对某个结果可用 dispute the result；围绕议题交换理由用 debate；人际口角常用 quarrel。

entries.definitionEn: To give reasons for a view or disagree with someone verbally.
entries.scenario: 既可争吵，也可提出理由支持观点

examples.en: She argues that the plan will work.
examples.zh: 她论证说这个计划能奏效。

entries.definitionEn: To question whether something is true or valid; a disagreement.
entries.scenario: 对事实、权利、结果等提出异议

examples.en: They disputed the figures.

entries.definitionEn: An angry disagreement, often about a personal matter; to argue angrily.
entries.scenario: 较偏人际冲突、口角，常带情绪

examples.en: They quarrelled about money.

entries.definitionEn: To discuss opposing views, often in a structured way.
entries.scenario: 围绕议题比较观点、理由，也可指内心权衡

examples.en: We debated whether to leave.

groups.selectionNote: 希望未来可能实现的事常用 hope；遗憾现在事实常用 wish + 过去式；遗憾过去常用 wish + had done。I wish to speak 是正式的“我想发言”，并不表示不可能。

entries.definitionEn: To want something, often something unreal or unlikely; to express a good desire for someone.
entries.scenario: 可表达与事实不符的愿望、遗憾；wish to do 较正式

examples.en: I wish I had more time.

entries.definitionEn: To want something to happen and think it may be possible.
entries.scenario: 希望某事发生，通常认为有可能

examples.en: I hope to see you soon.

groups.selectionNote: exchange 覆盖意见、货币、礼物等多种交流；swap 更常见于日常互换。exchange/swap A for B 表示拿A换B；与人交换则常用 with。

entries.definitionEn: To give and receive things, ideas, or information in return.
entries.scenario: 范围广，包括意见、货币、信息和物品

examples.en: We exchanged email addresses.

entries.definitionEn: To exchange one thing for another, often directly between two people.
entries.scenario: 更口语，常指双方直接交换两件东西或角色

examples.en: Can we swap seats?

groups.selectionNote: considerate 侧重顾及别人；thoughtful 既可贴心也可深思。注意 considerate 与 considerable（相当大的）拼写相似，词义却不同。

entries.definitionEn: Careful about other people's feelings and needs.
entries.scenario: 考虑别人感受，避免造成不便

examples.en: Please be considerate of others.

entries.definitionEn: Showing care for others or thinking carefully about something.
entries.scenario: 可指贴心行为，也可指认真思考的状态或成果

examples.en: That was a thoughtful gift.

groups.selectionNote: 气体凝结用 condense；压缩文件、气体体积用 compress。缩短文章时两者都可能成立：condense 更突出浓缩要点，compress 更突出压入更短篇幅。

entries.definitionEn: To make something shorter or more concentrated, or change gas into liquid.
entries.scenario: 气体变液体，或提炼内容使紧凑

examples.en: Condense the report into one page.

entries.definitionEn: To press into less space or reduce the size of data.
entries.scenario: 通过压力、编码等减少体积或占用空间

examples.en: Compress the file before sending it.

groups.selectionNote: 问一次行为的具体理由用 motive 很自然；问学习积极性用 motivation 更自然。motivation 也可指行为动机，不能把二者完全割裂。

entries.definitionEn: A reason for a particular action.
entries.scenario: 具体行动背后的原因，调查语境常见但未必负面

examples.en: Her motive was to help others.

entries.definitionEn: The desire or drive to act, or the reasons behind an action.
entries.scenario: 既可指行为原因，也常指行动积极性

examples.en: I lack the motivation to study.

groups.selectionNote: “有关联”不保证“切题”。related to 表联系，relevant to 表与当前目标相关；寻找写作论据时更应检查其是否 relevant。

entries.definitionEn: Directly connected to the matter being considered.
entries.scenario: 与当前问题、目标或任务有关

examples.en: Please give relevant examples.

entries.meaningZh: adj. 有联系的；有亲属关系的
entries.definitionEn: Connected in some way, or belonging to the same family.
entries.scenario: 只说明有联系，未必有助于当前问题

examples.en: Are these two events related?

groups.selectionNote: hasten 与 harry 不是一组可随便互换的同义词。若想表达“赶快”，常见词其实是 hurry；harry 则带有纠缠、反复施压的意味。

entries.definitionEn: To make something happen sooner or act without delay.
entries.scenario: 使过程更快，或急忙采取行动；较正式

examples.en: She hastened to explain.

entries.definitionEn: To repeatedly trouble, pressure, or attack someone.
entries.scenario: 反复攻击、逼迫或打扰；不是 hurry 的变体

examples.en: Reporters harried him with questions.
examples.zh: 记者不断用问题纠缠他。

groups.selectionNote: 原因义后面接名词或动名词，不直接接完整句子；完整原因从句可用 because。be due to arrive 中 to 是不定式标记，意思是预计到达，不是“因为到达”。

entries.definitionEn: Because of a particular cause or reason.
entries.scenario: 后接名词性成分，交代原因；较正式

examples.en: The match stopped owing to rain.

entries.definitionEn: Because of or caused by something.
entries.scenario: 现代英语中原因义与 owing to 广泛重叠

examples.en: The delay was due to a fault.

groups.selectionNote: 直接复制原话通常是 quote；交代依据来源通常是 cite。可以 cite 一项研究而完全不 quote 其原句，也可以同时做这两件事。

entries.definitionEn: To repeat someone's exact words or state a price.
entries.scenario: 强调复现原文，也可指提供价格

examples.en: She quoted a line from the poem.

entries.definitionEn: To mention a source, example, or fact as support.
entries.scenario: 指出来源、例证或理由，不必逐字复制

examples.en: He cited several studies.

groups.selectionNote: 预算怎么分、时间留给谁，常用 allocate；东西具体发到各处，常用 distribute。分配可能先于分发，但两词也会在资源分配语境中重叠。

entries.definitionEn: To assign resources to a particular person or purpose.
entries.scenario: 按计划决定资源归属或用途

examples.en: We allocated an hour to discussion.
examples.zh: 我们安排了一小时讨论。

entries.definitionEn: To give things out or spread them over an area.
entries.scenario: 把东西送到各处，或呈某种空间分布

examples.en: They distributed food to the villagers.

groups.selectionNote: protest 侧重表达反对，不保证不服从；defy 侧重违抗。defy explanation 意为难以解释，而不是“抗议解释”。

entries.definitionEn: To express strong disagreement or objection; an act of opposition.
entries.scenario: 表达反对；也可指坚称某事

examples.en: Students protested against the change.

entries.meaningZh: v. 公然违抗；使无法解释
entries.definitionEn: To openly refuse to obey, or resist explanation or expectation.
entries.scenario: 不服从命令或挑战预期、解释能力

examples.en: He defied the order to leave.

groups.selectionNote: 主动找出物品位置常用 locate，不用 situate 代替。描述建筑坐落位置，两者的被动结构 be located/situated in/near 都很常见。

entries.definitionEn: To find the position of something or establish it in a place.
entries.scenario: 可强调寻找定位，也可描述选址

examples.en: We finally located the missing file.
examples.zh: 我们终于找到了丢失的文件。

entries.definitionEn: To place something in a location or a particular context.
entries.scenario: 常用被动描述地点，也可放进概念背景

examples.en: The hotel is situated near the river.

groups.selectionNote: existence 问是否存在；presence 问是否在某处或当前情境中出现；absence 是未在场或缺乏。absence from class 指缺课，absence of evidence 指缺乏证据。

entries.definitionEn: Being in a place or existing there; also a noticeable personal quality.
entries.scenario: 强调某人某物在特定地点或情境中出现

examples.en: Your presence means a lot to me.
examples.zh: 你能在场对我意义重大。

entries.definitionEn: The state of being real or alive, or a way of living.
entries.scenario: 强调存在与否或生存状态

examples.en: They questioned the existence of the island.
examples.zh: 他们怀疑这座岛是否存在。

entries.definitionEn: The state of not being present or of something being missing.
entries.scenario: 某人没在场，或某物不存在于当前情境

examples.en: We worked in her absence.
examples.zh: 她不在时我们继续工作。

groups.selectionNote: 危险源可用 hazard，不良结果概率用 risk，危险处境常用 danger，文学或正式的险境可用 peril。真实语境会有重叠，这不是四个互斥类别。

entries.definitionEn: Serious danger.
entries.scenario: 较正式或文学化，强调处境凶险

examples.en: The ship was in peril.

entries.definitionEn: The possibility of harm or a situation that may cause it.
entries.scenario: 通用的危险状态或可能造成伤害的事物

examples.en: The building is in danger of collapse.

entries.definitionEn: The possibility of an unwanted outcome; to expose someone or something to it.
entries.scenario: 不良结果出现的可能性，或承担这种可能性

examples.en: There is a risk of delay.

entries.definitionEn: A source of potential harm or danger.
entries.scenario: 容易导致伤害或事故的因素

examples.en: Loose cables are a tripping hazard.
examples.zh: 松散的电缆有绊倒人的危险。

groups.selectionNote: 病人 contract a disease；病原体 infect a person。被动可用 be infected with。注意 contract 名词“合同”和动词“染病”的重音不同。

entries.meaningZh: v. 染上；收缩；n. 合同
entries.definitionEn: A binding agreement; as a verb, to make an agreement, become smaller, or catch an illness.
entries.scenario: 疾病义中，主语是患病者；词义依语境判断

examples.en: He contracted an infection abroad.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a person or organism to acquire an infection.
entries.scenario: 主语或来源导致别人感染；也可用于情绪感染

examples.en: The virus infected many people.

groups.selectionNote: 要付钱的账单常是 bill；已付款凭证常是 receipt；商业明细账单常是 invoice。invoice 不自动等于某地税务意义的发票，check 的账单义主要见于美式餐馆。

entries.definitionEn: A statement of money owed for goods or services.
entries.scenario: 常指要求支付的费用清单，另有法案等义

examples.en: Could we have the bill?

entries.definitionEn: A record confirming payment; also the act of receiving something.
entries.scenario: 收据义强调已支付的凭据；收到义较正式

examples.en: Keep the receipt as proof of payment.
examples.zh: 保留收据作为付款凭证。

entries.definitionEn: A detailed business bill requesting payment; to issue such a bill.
entries.scenario: 列出货物或服务与费用的商业单据

examples.en: The supplier sent an invoice.

entries.definitionEn: To examine; also a written bank payment order or, in American English, a restaurant bill.
entries.scenario: 美式可指餐馆账单；支票英式拼作 cheque

examples.en: Can we have separate checks?

groups.selectionNote: 装备总称 gear/equipment 通常不可数；一件具体装置用 a device。不能说 an equipment，可说 a piece of equipment。gear 的齿轮义则可数。

entries.definitionEn: Equipment for an activity, or a toothed wheel or speed setting in a machine.
entries.scenario: 装备义偏日常，常是某活动的一套用品

examples.en: Pack your swimming gear.

entries.definitionEn: The tools or items needed for an activity.
entries.scenario: 某用途所需工具设备的总称

examples.en: The laboratory needs new equipment.

entries.definitionEn: An object or piece of equipment designed for a particular purpose.
entries.scenario: 为某项用途设计的具体器具或装置

examples.en: This device measures temperature.

groups.selectionNote: 想表达松垂晃动用 dangle，一般悬挂用 hang。悬挂义过去式通常是 hung；hanged 通常用于绞刑义，不能作为所有语境的过去式。

entries.definitionEn: To hang loosely, often swinging back and forth.
entries.scenario: 从一端松松挂下，常有摆动感

examples.en: A key dangled from the chain.

entries.definitionEn: To be supported from above, or attach something so it is supported from above.
entries.scenario: 通用的挂起或垂下，不必晃动

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hook.

groups.selectionNote: 一名员工说 a staff member 或 a member of staff，不说 a personnel。staff 指整体时单复数谓语用法与英美习惯和集体/成员视角有关。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 员工总称；配备人员
entries.definitionEn: The people employed by an organization; to provide workers for it.
entries.scenario: 强调一个组织的工作团队

examples.en: The staff are very helpful.

entries.definitionEn: The people working for an organization; also matters involving employees.
entries.scenario: 较正式，常用于行政、人事或军事场景

examples.en: Only authorized personnel may enter.
examples.zh: 只有获授权人员可以进入。

groups.selectionNote: 强调形成或培养用 develop；强调推进或进步用 advance。advance a theory 是提出理论，不一定表示这套理论已经被证实。

entries.definitionEn: To grow, improve, or bring something into being over time.
entries.scenario: 逐步形成能力、产品、状态，也可指患病

examples.en: She developed an interest in art.
examples.zh: 她逐渐对艺术产生兴趣。

entries.meaningZh: v./n. 前进；推进；进展；提出；提前
entries.definitionEn: To move forward, make progress, or put forward an idea.
entries.scenario: 往前推动、提出观点，也可表示提前

examples.en: The researchers advanced a new theory.
examples.zh: 研究人员提出了一种新理论。

groups.selectionNote: evidence 支持某个判断，但力度不一；proof 通常更有足以确证的意味。evidence 通常不可数，数学中的一个证明则可说 a proof。

entries.definitionEn: Facts or information that help show whether something is true.
entries.scenario: 支持某判断的信息，力度可强可弱

examples.en: There is evidence of recent activity.

entries.definitionEn: Evidence or reasoning sufficient to establish that something is true.
entries.scenario: 一般指足以使人信服的证据，也指数学证明

examples.en: This is not proof of success.

groups.selectionNote: 外科手术专业用 surgeon；physician 的范围随地区与语境变化。与 surgeon 对举时常侧重内科，不能在所有英语地区都简单译成内科医生。

entries.definitionEn: A doctor trained to perform operations.
entries.scenario: 以手术治疗为专业方向

examples.en: The surgeon performed the operation.

entries.definitionEn: A medical doctor, especially one who treats illnesses without surgery.
entries.scenario: 美式可泛指医生；与 surgeon 对照时常指内科医生

examples.en: She works as a family physician.

groups.selectionNote: capable of 后接名词或动名词；competent at/in 常接领域或活动，competent to do 也可用。competent 表示胜任，不必贬低成“只是勉强合格”。

entries.definitionEn: Having the ability or potential to do something.
entries.scenario: 强调具有做成某事的能力或潜力

examples.en: He is capable of solving it.

entries.definitionEn: Having sufficient skill or knowledge to do something properly.
entries.scenario: 技能达到完成任务所需水平

examples.en: She is competent at her job.

groups.selectionNote: 谈新涌现的现象用 emergent；谈必须尽快处理的问题用 pressing。emergent 在特定专业语境能有紧急义，但日常不能普遍替代 urgent。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 新出现的；正在形成的
entries.definitionEn: Newly appearing or beginning to develop.
entries.scenario: 常指发展过程中涌现的事物或性质

examples.en: The team studies emergent patterns.
examples.zh: 团队研究新出现的模式。

entries.definitionEn: Urgent and needing attention soon.
entries.scenario: 需要尽快处理，强调迫切性

examples.en: Housing is a pressing issue.

groups.selectionNote: 变化、降低的幅度大常用 drastically；形容词或副词程度很高常用 extremely。extremely happy 很自然，drastically happy 则不是相应常用表达。

entries.definitionEn: To a great extent, especially when describing a major change.
entries.scenario: 修饰变化、减少或行动，强调幅度很大

examples.en: The rules changed drastically.

entries.definitionEn: To a very high degree.
entries.scenario: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词

examples.en: The instructions are extremely clear.

groups.selectionNote: 具体考试分数在英式语境常用 mark；课程等级常用 grade，但两者评分义有重叠。grade 的“年级”义和 mark 的“痕迹”义要另记。

entries.definitionEn: A score or visible sign; to assess work or make a sign.
entries.scenario: 英式学习语境常指具体分数，也有痕迹等义

examples.en: She got full marks in maths.

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 等级；成绩；年级；评分
entries.definitionEn: A level, school year, or assessment result; to classify or assess.
entries.scenario: 可指字母等级或课程成绩，美式也指年级

examples.en: He is in the sixth grade.

groups.selectionNote: 是否愿意看 unwilling/reluctant；是否犹豫看 hesitant。可以 reluctant 但仍然去做；hesitated 已是动词形式，应说 He hesitated，而不是 He was hesitated。

entries.definitionEn: Not wanting or not agreeing to do something.
entries.scenario: 直接表示缺乏意愿，拒绝态度可较明确

examples.en: He is unwilling to cooperate.

entries.definitionEn: Not eager to do something, often because of doubts or objections.
entries.scenario: 心有顾虑或勉强，不代表最终一定拒绝

examples.en: She was reluctant to leave.

entries.definitionEn: Slow to act or speak because you are uncertain.
entries.scenario: 不确定、紧张或缺乏信心而迟疑

examples.en: He sounded hesitant about the plan.
examples.zh: 听起来他对计划有些犹豫。

entries.meaningZh: v. hesitate 的过去式/过去分词
entries.definitionEn: Paused before acting or speaking because of uncertainty; past form of hesitate.
entries.scenario: 表示曾发生犹豫这一动作，不是普通形容词

examples.en: She hesitated before answering.

groups.selectionNote: complicate 是动作；complicated/complex 是描述性质。后两词有大量重叠，不是“贬义”和“中性”的绝对对立；不要说 It is complicate。

entries.definitionEn: To make something harder to understand or deal with.
entries.scenario: 动作：增加问题的难度或复杂程度

examples.en: Don't complicate matters.

entries.definitionEn: Having details or difficulties that make something hard to understand.
entries.scenario: 常强调细节多、难以理解或处理

examples.en: The instructions are complicated.

entries.definitionEn: Having many connected parts; also a group of related buildings or facilities.
entries.scenario: 常强调多个部分相互关联，不必带负面评价

examples.en: The brain is a complex system.

groups.selectionNote: 称赞用 compliment/praise，内心钦佩用 admire，感激或认可价值用 appreciate。complement 是补充，不是称赞；flatter 也可指衣服衬人，未必都是奉承。

entries.definitionEn: An expression of admiration or approval; to give one.
entries.scenario: 通常是针对外貌、表现等的具体赞美

examples.en: He complimented me on my presentation.

entries.definitionEn: Something that completes or improves another thing; to combine well with it.
entries.scenario: 让另一事物更完整或更协调，不是夸奖

examples.en: Their skills complement each other.

entries.definitionEn: To express approval or admiration; words of approval.
entries.scenario: 对表现、品质或成就表达肯定，范围较广

examples.en: The teacher praised her effort.

entries.definitionEn: To praise someone, often excessively, or make them look more attractive.
entries.scenario: 可能为取悦别人而过度夸赞；也可指衣着衬人

examples.en: That colour flatters you.

entries.definitionEn: To respect someone or look at something with pleasure.
entries.scenario: 可以是内心赞赏，不一定当面说出

examples.en: I admire her courage.

entries.meaningZh: v. 感激；欣赏；理解价值
entries.definitionEn: To recognize value, feel grateful, or understand a situation fully.
entries.scenario: 强调认可价值、感谢帮助，也可指理解情况

examples.en: I appreciate your patience.

groups.selectionNote: face 范围较广，可指被动面临或主动处理；confront 常更有正面处理、对质的力度。confront sb with evidence 是拿证据与某人对质。

entries.definitionEn: To deal directly with a difficulty or challenge someone face to face.
entries.scenario: 常强调直接处理问题或当面提出争议

examples.en: She confronted him with the evidence.

entries.definitionEn: To deal with or be presented with something; the front of the head.
entries.scenario: 泛指面临或处理，不一定发生正面对质

examples.en: We face a difficult choice.

groups.selectionNote: 日常推想常用 suppose；证据不足而推测常用 speculate。be supposed to do 常表示应该或按安排做，与 speculate 的猜测义不能直接互换。

entries.definitionEn: To think something is likely or assume something for discussion.
entries.scenario: 常见于日常推想，或引出假设情况

examples.en: I suppose he's busy.

entries.definitionEn: To form ideas without enough evidence, or invest for uncertain profit.
entries.scenario: 根据有限证据猜测，也可指金融投机

examples.en: We speculated about the cause.

groups.selectionNote: 这组原词词性不平行：prejudice 常是名词，discriminate 是动词。若比较两个名词，应用 prejudice 与 discrimination；前者偏态度，后者歧视义偏行为。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 偏见；使有偏见；损害
entries.definitionEn: An unfair judgment made without sufficient knowledge; to bias or harm.
entries.scenario: 常指未充分了解便形成的态度，也可作动词

examples.en: Prejudice can influence judgment.

entries.definitionEn: To treat people unfairly based on group identity, or recognize differences.
entries.scenario: 歧视义指区别对待；辨别义可为中性

examples.en: They discriminated against older applicants.
examples.zh: 他们歧视年龄较大的申请人。

groups.selectionNote: 比较碰撞义时，clip 常指短促击打或擦撞边缘，如 The car clipped the kerb；bump 指碰到、撞上，常但不一定力度较轻，如 I bumped into the table。clip 并不一定是故意动作；bump 也不一定只限于意外。bump into someone 还可表示偶遇。clip 的夹子、短片、夹住和剪等义需另按语境理解。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 夹子；短片；夹住；剪；击打或擦撞
entries.definitionEn: A fastener or short extract; to fasten, cut, or hit something briefly, often at an edge.
entries.scenario: 除夹、剪外，也可指快速击打或擦撞物体边缘；与 bump 的碰撞义有交叉

examples.en: The car clipped the kerb as it turned.
examples.zh: 汽车转弯时擦撞了路缘。

entries.definitionEn: A small raised area or a light collision; to hit something accidentally.
entries.scenario: 常指不太猛烈的撞击或表面不平

examples.en: I bumped into the table.

groups.selectionNote: slender 强调细长修长，slim 强调苗条匀称，skinny 常有很瘦的评价。slim/slender chance 都可表示机会渺茫，不能都照身材义理解。

entries.definitionEn: Thin and graceful; also small or limited in amount.
entries.scenario: 强调细而长，常带优雅感；也可形容微小机会

examples.en: She has slender fingers.

entries.meaningZh: adj./v. 苗条的；微小的；减肥
entries.definitionEn: Attractively thin; also small in probability; to lose weight.
entries.scenario: 身材义常是褒义，不一定强调高或长

examples.en: He has a slim build.

entries.definitionEn: Very thin, often in a way considered unattractive or unhealthy.
entries.scenario: 常带瘦得过头的感觉；服装义可为中性

examples.en: His legs are rather skinny.

groups.selectionNote: span 常看两端跨度，range 常看上下限或种类。a price range 指价格范围，a time span 指时间跨度；两者有交叉但搭配不同。

entries.definitionEn: The distance or time between two limits; to extend across them.
entries.scenario: 强调两端之间的长度或持续时间

examples.en: Her career spanned four decades.
examples.zh: 她的职业生涯长达四十年。

entries.definitionEn: The limits, variety, or extent of something; to vary between limits.
entries.scenario: 强调上下限、覆盖范围或可选种类

examples.en: The shop sells a wide range of books.
examples.zh: 这家店出售种类繁多的书。

groups.selectionNote: vote 既可指投票行为也可数票；ballot 常突出选票或投票程序。by secret ballot 表示无记名投票，不意味着只能使用纸张。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 选票；投票；进行投票
entries.definitionEn: A voting paper or a voting process, usually secret; to hold a vote.
entries.scenario: 常强调正式表决的方式、程序或一轮投票

examples.en: The decision was made by ballot.
examples.zh: 这项决定是投票作出的。

entries.definitionEn: A formal expression of choice; to express that choice in a decision.
entries.scenario: 可以指行为、票数、表决或投票权

examples.en: I voted against the proposal.

groups.selectionNote: 打算做什么常用 intention；更正式的意图常用 intent；为什么做或某物有何用途用 purpose。intent on 中 on 是介词，后接名词或动名词。 intent 与 intention 的名词义大幅重叠；不能把 intent 固定解释为动机、intention 固定解释为计划。motive 更直接回答促使行动的原因，而 intent 常说明意图实现什么。

entries.definitionEn: An aim or intention; as an adjective, focused or firmly determined.
entries.scenario: 名词较正式；形容词表示一心投入

examples.en: She is intent on finishing today.

entries.definitionEn: Something you plan or mean to do.
entries.scenario: 常用于某人计划做或不做某事

examples.en: I have no intention of leaving.

entries.definitionEn: The reason something is done or the use it is designed for.
entries.scenario: 回答为什么做、用来干什么或有什么意义

examples.en: What is the purpose of this button?

groups.selectionNote: 山顶义 summit/peak 可重叠；领导人峰会用 summit；需求或销量峰值用 peak。peak 可作动词：Sales peaked，summit 通常不这样表达数值达到峰值。

entries.definitionEn: The top of a mountain or a meeting of leaders.
entries.scenario: 山的最高点，或领导人的高级别会议

examples.en: The leaders attended a summit.
examples.zh: 领导人出席了一场峰会。

entries.meaningZh: n./v./adj. 山峰；峰值；达到顶峰的
entries.definitionEn: A mountain top or highest level; to reach the highest point.
entries.scenario: 实体峰顶或抽象数值、水平的最高点

examples.en: Sales peaked in June.

groups.selectionNote: neglect 可为未照料、未注意或未尽责，不一定故意；an oversight 常是无意遗漏。监督义 oversight 通常不可数，需结合 government/regulatory 等上下文判断。

entries.definitionEn: To fail to give necessary care or attention; such a failure.
entries.scenario: 未给予应有的注意或照顾，可长期也可一次

examples.en: The garden suffered from neglect.
examples.zh: 花园因疏于照料而荒废。

entries.definitionEn: An accidental omission or mistake; also supervision.
entries.scenario: an oversight 指无意遗漏；监督义通常不可数

examples.en: The error was an oversight.

groups.selectionNote: 职称按具体机构正式名称理解，associate、vice-、deputy 不能排成普遍通用的职级高低表。associate 还可作联系的动词，vice 单独作名词常是恶习。

entries.definitionEn: To connect ideas or people; a colleague; sometimes a lower-ranking title.
entries.scenario: 职称表示专业级别或关联身份，不能统一排职级

examples.en: She is an associate professor.

entries.definitionEn: In job titles, a prefix indicating a deputy or second-in-command.
entries.scenario: 常出现在副职称中；单独名词 vice 另有恶习等义

examples.en: The vice-president gave a speech.

entries.definitionEn: Someone who assists a leader and can act in their place.
entries.scenario: 强调协助负责人，或获授权代行职责

examples.en: The deputy manager is in charge today.

groups.selectionNote: mix 只是混合，blend 常暗示协调或均匀；两者在食物语境有重叠。mix up names 是混淆名字，blend into the crowd 是融入人群。

entries.definitionEn: To combine things, which may remain distinguishable; a combination.
entries.scenario: 把不同东西放在一起，不要求完全融合

examples.en: Mix the flour with water.

entries.definitionEn: To combine smoothly into a unified mixture.
entries.scenario: 常强调均匀、协调、不容易分辨各部分

examples.en: Her voice blended with the music.
examples.zh: 她的声音与音乐融为一体。

groups.selectionNote: A and B constitute C 是组成关系；construct C 是建造过程。constitute a threat 的意思是构成威胁，而不是人为建造一个威胁物体。

entries.meaningZh: v. 构成；算作；正式建立
entries.definitionEn: To make up something, count as something, or formally establish it.
entries.scenario: 说明组成关系，或某行为性质属于什么

examples.en: These errors constitute a serious problem.
examples.zh: 这些错误构成严重问题。

entries.definitionEn: To build something by putting parts together.
entries.scenario: 实际建造或有步骤组织抽象内容

examples.en: They constructed a model of the system.
examples.zh: 他们建立了该系统的模型。

groups.selectionNote: brutal 强调残暴、强烈或严酷；cruel 强调造成痛苦或不顾他人痛苦；relentless 强调持续、不放松。a brutal attack 是残暴袭击，a cruel joke 是伤人的玩笑，relentless effort 是不懈努力。relentless 可赞扬坚持，不能一概译为“残忍”；relentless attacks 则可带负面意义。 和第36组相比，persistent 强调持续或反复，tenacious 强调紧抓不放，relentless 更强调强度不减。ruthless 偏为达目的不顾他人，merciless 偏不留情，harsh 偏严厉或刺耳；这些也不是严格的强弱等级。

entries.definitionEn: Extremely violent, harsh, or direct.
entries.scenario: 常强调暴力程度或毫不留情

examples.en: The winter was brutal.

entries.definitionEn: Causing suffering without caring, or deliberately causing it.
entries.scenario: 使人或动物受苦，或不顾他人痛苦

examples.en: It was a cruel joke.

entries.meaningZh: adj. 持续不减的；毫不松懈的
entries.definitionEn: Continuing with great intensity or determination without easing or stopping.
entries.scenario: 强调压力、努力或追求持续不止；既可褒义也可贬义，不必含残忍意味

examples.en: They continued their relentless search.

groups.selectionNote: 义务义两者大多可互换，不要硬分成道德义务与法律义务。much obliged 是表达感谢的固定用法，一般不用 much obligated 替换。

entries.meaningZh: adj./过去分词：有义务的；感激的
entries.definitionEn: Required to do something; also grateful for a favor.
entries.scenario: 义务义与 obligated 重叠，另有感谢义

examples.en: I'm much obliged for your help.

entries.definitionEn: Bound by a duty, promise, or rule to do something.
entries.scenario: 常见于美式英语，强调承担责任或义务

examples.en: I felt obligated to reply.

groups.selectionNote: agreement 最宽泛，pact 常显得郑重，contract 常是明确权利义务的合同。是否有法律约束力不能仅靠词名判断，这里比较的是常见英语用法。

entries.definitionEn: A serious agreement between people, groups, or countries.
entries.scenario: 常为较郑重承诺，可涉及国家也可涉及个人

examples.en: We made a pact to keep in touch.

entries.definitionEn: A binding agreement; as a verb, to make an agreement, become smaller, or catch an illness.
entries.scenario: 常明确双方权利义务，也有其他动词义

examples.en: They signed a two-year contract.
examples.zh: 他们签了一份两年期合同。

entries.definitionEn: A shared decision, arrangement, or state of having the same opinion.
entries.scenario: 最宽泛，可指正式协议或单纯达成共识

examples.en: We finally reached an agreement.

groups.selectionNote: crew 看共同执行的专门工作；staff 看机构员工身份；stuff 是东西。说 a crew member / a staff member；stuff 通常不可数，不说 many stuffs。

entries.meaningZh: n. 工作团队；机组；船员
entries.definitionEn: A team working together, especially on a ship, aircraft, or production.
entries.scenario: 共同操作交通工具或完成特定工作的一组人

examples.en: The film crew arrived early.

entries.definitionEn: The people employed by an organization; to provide workers for it.
entries.scenario: 机构或企业的员工团队，不限于同一具体任务

examples.en: Ask a member of staff for help.

entries.definitionEn: Things or material in general; to fill something tightly.
entries.scenario: 名词通常不可数且较口语；与员工无关

examples.en: Don't leave your stuff here.
examples.zh: 别把你的东西留在这里。

groups.selectionNote: 引发行动用 prompt；强烈劝说用 urge；给予信心支持用 encourage。prompt 的及时义、提示义都很常见，不只用于AI提示词。

entries.definitionEn: To cause action or give a cue; quick to act; a cue or instruction.
entries.scenario: 可引发行动或反应，也指及时回应与提示内容

examples.en: The news prompted a debate.

entries.definitionEn: To strongly encourage action; a strong desire to do something.
entries.scenario: 劝说力度强，常带急迫感

examples.en: They urged me to apply.

entries.definitionEn: To give confidence or support, or make something more likely.
entries.scenario: 给予支持和信心，或使某行为更可能发生

examples.en: She encouraged me to keep trying.

groups.selectionNote: 借入用 borrow，借出用 lend。lend 的过去式是 lent；表达“保留借来的物品多久”常用 keep，例如 Can I keep it for a week?

entries.definitionEn: To take something temporarily with the intention of returning it.
entries.scenario: 主语暂时拿来别人的东西

examples.en: I borrowed a book from Tom.

entries.definitionEn: To let someone use something temporarily with the expectation of its return.
entries.scenario: 主语把东西暂时交给别人；过去式 lent

examples.en: Tom lent me a book.

groups.selectionNote: 人 spend 时间 doing，物 cost 人多少钱，It takes 人 时间 to do，人 pay 钱 for 物。不要把 spend time doing 写成 spend time to do。

entries.definitionEn: To use money, time, or effort on something.
entries.scenario: 以人或组织为主语，花钱或花时间

examples.en: I spent an hour reading.

entries.definitionEn: To require money, time, or sacrifice; the amount required.
entries.scenario: 以物品或事情为主语，表示使人付出钱或代价

examples.en: The book cost me £10.

entries.definitionEn: In time expressions, to require a particular amount of time.
entries.scenario: 说明活动所需时间，常用形式主语 it
collocations: It takes sb time to do

examples.en: It took me an hour to finish.

entries.definitionEn: To give money for something or settle a debt; wages.
entries.scenario: 强调付钱的动作；也可表示付出代价

examples.en: I paid £10 for the book.

groups.selectionNote: remember to do 是记得要做；remember doing 是记得做过。remind 是让别人记起，常要接人的宾语；recall doing 适用于回想过去经历。

entries.definitionEn: To keep something in your memory or bring it back to mind.
entries.scenario: 记住未来任务或回想过去经历

examples.en: Remember to close the window.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone remember or think of something.
entries.scenario: 让另一个人想起；通常需要人的宾语

examples.en: Remind me to call her.

entries.definitionEn: To bring something back to mind; also to officially request its return.
entries.scenario: 回想过去，较正式；也可召回产品

examples.en: I recall meeting her before.

groups.selectionNote: adapt 调整以适应；adopt 接受采用或收养。adapt to 的 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词；adopt a method 中不需要 to。

entries.definitionEn: To adjust to new conditions or change something for a new use.
entries.scenario: 改变自身或事物以适合新环境、用途

examples.en: It takes time to adapt to change.

entries.definitionEn: To begin using an idea or method, or legally take a child into your family.
entries.scenario: 接受方法、政策或态度，也可收养孩子

examples.en: We adopted a new approach.

groups.selectionNote: 经济政策用 economic，节省运行成本用 economical。economic 在部分语境也有合算义，所以不是所有省钱表达都只能用 economical；先记常见搭配。

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the economy or the study of economics.
entries.scenario: 常说明与经济活动有关，而非一定省钱

examples.en: The country faces economic problems.
examples.zh: 这个国家面临经济问题。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 节约的；经济实惠的
entries.definitionEn: Using money, fuel, or other resources carefully and without waste.
entries.scenario: 强调使用金钱、燃料、时间等较节省

examples.en: This car is economical to run.

groups.selectionNote: 确保结果常用 ensure；让人放心常用 assure sb；投保常用 insure。美式 insure 有时也能表示确保，但不要据此把所有句型互换。

entries.definitionEn: To make certain that something happens or is true.
entries.scenario: 采取行动使结果可靠地发生

examples.en: Check the lock to ensure safety.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone confidently that something is true so they feel less worried.
entries.scenario: 常对某人作保证，直接宾语通常是人

examples.en: I assured him that I would help.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange or provide financial protection against specified risks.
entries.scenario: 常用于保险，也有确保义，尤其美式用法

examples.en: The house is insured against fire.

groups.selectionNote: efficient 看资源利用，effective 看是否奏效。方法可以有效但低效，也可能执行高效却未实现目标；两词关注不同评价维度。

entries.definitionEn: Achieving a result with little wasted time, energy, or resources.
entries.scenario: 用较少的资源、时间或精力完成工作

examples.en: The new system is more efficient.

entries.definitionEn: Producing the intended result; also officially in force.
entries.scenario: 达到预期效果，或正式开始适用

examples.en: The method is effective but slow.

groups.selectionNote: 收到邀请用 receive，决定应邀用 accept。receive 不表示一定自愿接受；accept responsibility 又是承担责任，不能简单译为收到责任。

entries.definitionEn: To willingly take, agree to, or recognize something.
entries.scenario: 态度上同意接纳，不只是到手

examples.en: She accepted the invitation.

entries.definitionEn: To get something that is sent, given, or provided.
entries.scenario: 东西、信息、待遇等到达，不必表示同意

examples.en: She received the invitation yesterday.

groups.selectionNote: possible 只说有可能，likely/probable 通常倾向很可能，但不能固定成百分比。说 He is likely to come；不说 He is possible/probable to come。

entries.definitionEn: Expected to happen or probably true.
entries.scenario: 常用于预测人或事物会怎样

examples.en: She is likely to win.

entries.definitionEn: Able to happen or be done, without saying it is likely.
entries.scenario: 未被排除，未必概率很大

examples.en: It is possible that he forgot.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to happen or be true.
entries.scenario: 比仅仅 possible 更倾向会发生，较正式

examples.en: Rain is the probable cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 雨很可能是延误的原因。

groups.selectionNote: 形容“你很有条理”用 You are organized；说“组织协调能力”用 organizational skills。organized 是对状态或特点的评价，organizational 是“与组织管理有关”的关系形容词。organized activities 是有组织的活动；organizational changes 是组织层面的变动。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 有条理的；有组织的
entries.definitionEn: Able to plan things neatly and effectively; also arranged in a structured way.
entries.scenario: 形容人做事有条理，或活动经过安排；也可作 organize 的过去式/过去分词

examples.en: She is organized and always meets deadlines.
examples.zh: 她做事有条理，总能按时完成任务。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 组织的；组织管理方面的
entries.definitionEn: Relating to how an organization or activity is structured, managed, or coordinated.
entries.scenario: 说明与组织结构、管理或协调能力有关，不直接表示一个人有条理

examples.en: The job requires strong organizational skills.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求很强的组织协调能力。

groups.selectionNote: assign 回答“把什么交给谁”，arrange 回答“怎么安排好”。可以先 assign tasks to team members，再 arrange a meeting。安排某人做事常用 arrange for sb to do，不能机械套成 arrange sb to do。原网站的 appoint / arrange 仍保留，appoint 侧重正式任命。

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a task or role, or designate something for a particular use.
entries.scenario: 把具体任务、角色或资源交给某人，也可给事物赋值或归类

examples.en: The teacher assigned each student a topic.
examples.zh: 老师给每名学生分配了一个题目。

entries.definitionEn: To plan something or put things in a particular order.
entries.scenario: 协调时间、活动或摆放顺序，重点不在把任务交给谁

examples.en: We arranged for a taxi to pick her up.
examples.zh: 我们安排了一辆出租车去接她。

groups.selectionNote: 同一栋房子可以是你的 property，也可以是你的 asset：前者强调所有权或房产类别，后者强调经济价值。property 作财产总称通常不可数，但 a property 可指一处房产；properties 也可指性质。asset 可数，常用复数 assets；名词 property 没有“团队优势”这个常见用法。

entries.definitionEn: Something owned, especially land or buildings; also a characteristic of a thing.
entries.scenario: 所有物的总称；也指房地产或事物的特性，强调归属或性质

examples.en: This land is private property.

entries.meaningZh: n. 资产；有价值的人或事物
entries.definitionEn: Something valuable or useful, especially a resource with economic value.
entries.scenario: 强调具有经济价值、能带来益处；可包括现金、专利、技能等

examples.en: Her language skills are an asset to the team.
examples.zh: 她的语言能力是团队的一大优势。

groups.selectionNote: “参加比赛”通常说 enter a contest 或 compete in a contest。compete 常接 in、for、with/against；contest 作动词可直接接 election、seat、decision 等。contest a decision 是质疑决定，不是参加决定；contest an election 可指参与竞选，具体含义要看宾语和语境。

entries.definitionEn: A competition; as a verb, to compete for something or formally challenge a claim or decision.
entries.scenario: 名词常指一项评选或比赛；动词常指争夺席位，或正式质疑决定

examples.en: They contested the result of the election.
examples.zh: 他们对选举结果提出了异议。

entries.definitionEn: To try to win or succeed against others in an event, activity, or market.
entries.scenario: 通常不及物，强调与别人竞争的行为

examples.en: Athletes compete for medals.
examples.zh: 运动员为争夺奖牌而比赛。

groups.selectionNote: trash 与 garbage 在美式日常用法中有大量重叠，不能硬分成“干垃圾”和“湿垃圾”。junk 更突出废旧杂物或低质量东西。三者作这些总称时通常不可数，用 a piece of junk / a bag of garbage。英式英语常用 rubbish；junk food 并非字面上的垃圾。

entries.definitionEn: Unwanted material to be thrown away; also worthless content; to discard or criticize harshly.
entries.scenario: 美式常用垃圾总称，也指无价值的内容；作动词可指丢弃或严厉批评

examples.en: Please take out the trash.

entries.definitionEn: Unwanted or low-value things, especially old objects; to throw them away.
entries.scenario: 偏指不需要、质量差或无价值的物品，不一定已经被扔进垃圾桶

examples.en: The garage is full of old junk.
examples.zh: 车库里堆满了废旧杂物。

entries.definitionEn: Waste, often household or food waste; also ideas or statements considered worthless.
entries.scenario: 美式常指生活垃圾，尤其常见于厨余语境，也能泛指垃圾或胡说

examples.en: Put the food scraps in the garbage.
examples.zh: 把食物残渣扔进垃圾里。

groups.selectionNote: strain 不能只记为“拉伤”：under strain 表示承受压力，a muscle strain 是肌肉或肌腱拉伤，a strain of bacteria 是细菌菌株。strain to do 表示费力做，strain one's eyes 是过度用眼，strain the soup 是过滤汤。sprain 通常指韧带扭伤；不要把它与 strain 的损伤义混为一谈。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 压力；拉伤；品系；用力；过滤
entries.definitionEn: Pressure or excessive effort; an injury from overstretching; a biological variety; to exert effort or filter liquid.
entries.scenario: 多义词：精神或身体的负担、肌肉拉伤、生物品系；动词可指使劲或滤去液体中的固体

examples.en: She strained to hear the quiet voice.
examples.zh: 她竭力想听清那个轻轻的声音。

groups.selectionNote: 续订会员、续期证件用 renew；翻新房屋用 renovate。renew hope / renew efforts 表示重新燃起希望或再次努力。renovate 通常针对旧建筑和室内空间，不用来表达“续费会员”。名词分别是 renewal 和 renovation。

entries.meaningZh: v. 续期；重新开始；恢复
entries.definitionEn: To extend a period of validity, start again, or restore strength or freshness.
entries.scenario: 让期限延长或让某种状态再次出现，不一定涉及实体改造

examples.en: I need to renew my library membership.
examples.zh: 我需要续办图书馆会员资格。

entries.definitionEn: To repair and improve an old building or room.
entries.scenario: 主要修复、改善旧建筑或房间，让它重新处于良好状态

examples.en: They renovated the old kitchen.

groups.selectionNote: “我醒着”说 I am awake；“我醒了”说 I woke up；“他叫醒我”说 He woke me up。rouse 常带从沉睡或消极状态中唤起的意味，也能激起兴趣或行动。awake 作形容词通常放在 be、stay、keep 等后面；放在名词前通常不自然，可说 a child who is awake。作动词时常说 awake from sleep，不通常说 awake up。

entries.definitionEn: To wake someone, make them active, or stir a strong feeling.
entries.scenario: 从睡眠、不活跃状态中唤起，也常指激起情绪或行动，较有力度

examples.en: The speech roused the audience to action.
examples.zh: 演讲激发了听众采取行动。

entries.definitionEn: To stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping.
entries.scenario: 最常见的日常动词，可及物或不及物，常与 up 连用

examples.en: Please wake me up at seven.

entries.definitionEn: Not asleep; as a verb, to stop sleeping or become aware.
entries.scenario: 形容词用法常见，作表语表示没有睡着；动词较正式，常不用 up

examples.en: I was still awake at midnight.

groups.selectionNote: predict 是通用的预测、预言；forecast 常用于天气、经济、销量等预报，往往依据数据；foresee 强调提前意识到或预见某种情况。区别是常见语境与表达重点，不是“能否预测数字”的语法禁令。温度预报常说 forecast/predict the temperature；foresee problems/consequences 更典型。foresee–foresaw–foreseen；forecast 的过去式和过去分词可用 forecast 或 forecasted。

entries.definitionEn: To realize in advance that a future event or problem may occur.
entries.scenario: 根据情况预先意识到未来可能发生的事，不强调具体量化方法

examples.en: We did not foresee these delays.
examples.zh: 我们没有预见到这些延误。

entries.definitionEn: To estimate a future condition or trend, often using available data; the estimate itself.
entries.scenario: 常依据数据或模型预测天气、经济等趋势及数值

examples.en: The report forecasts slower growth.

entries.definitionEn: To say what you think will happen in the future.
entries.scenario: 最通用，可根据证据、经验或直觉说未来会怎样

examples.en: Experts predict more rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 专家预测明天会有更多降雨。

groups.selectionNote: calculate 是通用的计算，compute 多用于技术、数学或机器按规则运算。日常算账用 calculate the bill 自然；软件算平均值可用 compute the average。两者在数学语境可互换，但 compute 不等于“电脑”这个名词。

entries.definitionEn: To work out a result by following mathematical steps, especially with a computer.
entries.scenario: 偏正式或技术语境，按步骤或算法算出结果，常用于计算机处理

examples.en: The software computes the average automatically.
examples.zh: 软件会自动计算平均值。

entries.definitionEn: To find a number or amount by using mathematics or careful reasoning.
entries.scenario: 通用词，强调用数字或推理求出结果，也可指有意筹划

examples.en: Can you calculate the total cost?

groups.selectionNote: 跳水或潜水常用 dive；plunge 强调突然、猛烈地进入或下降，也可有意进行。两词都能描述价格急跌：Share prices dived/plunged. 不可把 dive 限定为受控运动，也不能把 plunge 限定为意外失控。plunge a room into darkness 是使房间突然陷入黑暗；dive into a task 是迅速投入任务。dive–dived–dived；美式过去式也常用 dove，过去分词通常仍用 dived。

entries.meaningZh: v./n. 跳水；潜水；俯冲；骤降
entries.definitionEn: To enter water, swim underwater, move down quickly, or fall sharply in value.
entries.scenario: 可指跳入水中、潜水、俯冲、迅速投入；也可描述价格暴跌，不保证动作始终受控

examples.en: She dived into the pool.

entries.definitionEn: To move or fall suddenly and forcefully into something, or decrease sharply.
entries.scenario: 强调突然、猛烈地进入或下落；不要求有技巧或头朝下

examples.en: The room was plunged into darkness.

groups.selectionNote: nation 与 country 在许多“国家”语境中重叠。nation 常突出人民的共同身份、历史或政治共同体；country 常突出领土、政府和地理实体。一个 nation 不一定对应一个独立 country；不要把 nation 简化为只能指民族。the country 还可表示乡村，in the country 不能直接换成 in the nation。 country 并非在所有名称中都意味着独立主权国家，例如 Scotland 常称为 a country，属于 the United Kingdom。共同语言或血缘不是 nation 在所有用法中的必要条件。

entries.definitionEn: A large community sharing history or identity; also a country considered as a political community.
entries.scenario: 突出共享历史、文化或身份的人群；也可指作为政治共同体的国家

examples.en: The whole nation celebrated the victory.

entries.definitionEn: A territory regarded as a distinct political or geographical unit; also rural land outside towns.
entries.scenario: 通常指政治地理实体，也可指一个较大国家内部称为 country 的组成部分；the country 还指乡村

examples.en: She has visited several countries.

entries.definitionEn: A ship, a container, or a tube carrying fluid in the body.
entries.scenario: 较正式，具体类别靠修饰语判断

examples.en: The vessel carries cargo.

entries.definitionEn: A small simple house, or a compartment in a ship or aircraft.
entries.scenario: 指小屋或运输工具中的封闭空间

examples.en: We stayed in a cabin by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们住在湖边的小木屋里。

groups.selectionNote: 船舶语境中，vessel 指整艘船，cabin 指船内供人居住或使用的舱室：a cabin on a vessel。它们是整体与内部空间的区别，不是两种船的名称。cabin 也可指飞机客舱或小木屋；vessel 还可指容器及血管，如 a blood vessel。此组由原第77组拆出，词条与例句保留。

entries.meaningZh: n. 通讯记者；驻地／特派记者；通信者
entries.definitionEn: A journalist who reports for a news organization on a particular place or subject; also, a person who exchanges letters.
entries.scenario: 强调为媒体报道特定地区、领域或事件，不一定驻外

examples.en: She works as a foreign correspondent in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 她在东京担任驻外记者。

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to gather, write, edit, or present news.
entries.scenario: 新闻行业从业者的通称，范围较广，不限于现场采访

examples.en: The journalist investigated the company for six months.
examples.zh: 这名记者对该公司进行了六个月的调查。

groups.selectionNote: journalist 是新闻工作者的通称，既可采访，也可写稿、编辑或制作新闻；correspondent 通常负责特定地区、领域或事件的报道。多数新闻 correspondent 属于 journalist，但并非所有 journalist 都是 correspondent。correspondent 还可指通信者，需结合上下文判断。

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling that someone or something is unworthy of respect.
entries.scenario: 认为对方低劣或不值得尊重；亦用于藐视法庭等法律表达

examples.en: He showed contempt for anyone who disagreed with him.
examples.zh: 他对任何不同意他的人都表现出轻蔑。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 鄙夷；轻蔑；不屑于做
entries.definitionEn: A feeling or expression of strong disrespect; as a verb, to reject or regard something with contempt.
entries.scenario: 常带轻蔑的拒绝或嘲讽；可说 scorn an offer 和 scorn to do sth

examples.en: She poured scorn on the suggestion that she had cheated.
examples.zh: 她对关于她作弊的说法嗤之以鼻。

groups.selectionNote: contempt 侧重认为某人或某事不值得尊重的轻蔑态度；scorn 常带更明显的鄙夷、嘲讽或不屑，但不能绝对区分为“内心”和“外在”。二者都可表达或隐藏，也没有固定的强度等级。contempt 常作不可数名词；scorn 还可作及物动词。注意 in contempt of court 是“藐视法庭”，scorn 不能直接替换。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 持续的；频繁的；不变的；n. 常数
entries.definitionEn: Continuing or happening repeatedly, or remaining unchanged; as a noun, a fixed value.
entries.scenario: 强调持续性、反复性或保持同一数值，具体含义取决于搭配

examples.en: Keep the temperature constant during the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验过程中要保持温度不变。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 一贯的；稳定的；相符的
entries.definitionEn: Always behaving or happening in a similar way, or agreeing with other facts or ideas.
entries.scenario: 强调不同时间、行为或信息之间没有矛盾，或稳定达到相近标准

examples.en: Her explanation is consistent with the evidence.

groups.selectionNote: constant 强调持续、反复发生，或数值不变；consistent 强调前后表现稳定、遵循同一标准，或与某事相符。constant practice 强调经常练习，consistent practice 强调有规律地坚持。constant noise 可以反复出现，并不要求一秒不停；consistent 不表示结果永远完全一样。be consistent with 表示“与……一致”。

entries.definitionEn: Slightly wet, often in a pleasant or useful way.
entries.scenario: 常指适量水分，尤用于土壤、皮肤和食物，不等于浸湿

examples.en: Cover the cake to keep it moist.
examples.zh: 把蛋糕盖好，让它保持湿润。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 湿的；被液体浸湿的；v. 弄湿
entries.definitionEn: Covered with or containing water or another liquid; as a verb, to make something wet.
entries.scenario: 最通用，可说头发、衣服或路面有水，也可指多雨天气

examples.en: My shoes got wet in the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Slightly wet, often in a way that feels unpleasant.
entries.scenario: 通常只有少量水分，常用于衣服、墙壁或空气，往往令人不适

examples.en: The clothes are still damp.

entries.meaningZh: adj. 空气潮湿的；湿热的
entries.definitionEn: Containing a lot of water vapour, used especially of air or weather.
entries.scenario: 强调空气水汽多，常用于天气和气候；不必然表示气温高

examples.en: Summers here are hot and humid.

groups.selectionNote: wet 是最通用的“湿”，可指有水或被液体浸湿；moist 常指含适量水分，食物语境往往是正面的“湿润”；damp 通常指微湿，衣物、房间语境常带不舒服的感觉；humid 专指空气或气候中水汽较多。moist soil、damp soil 都自然，褒贬只是常见倾向，并非硬性规则；humid 不表示物体表面被水打湿。

entries.meaningZh: n. 进入；参赛作品；条目
entries.definitionEn: The act of entering, a submitted item, or an item in a record.
entries.scenario: 强调进入行为、资格或记录，不专指门口

examples.en: Entry to the museum is free.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people enter, or the act of entering.
entries.scenario: 常指可以走进去的入口，也可指进场动作

examples.en: Meet me at the main entrance.

groups.selectionNote: entry 常强调进入的行为、资格、参赛作品或记录条目；entrance 常强调入口位置，也可表示进入的动作。入口说 the entrance to the building；准入说 entry to the building。entrance exam 是入学考试。

entries.meaningZh: v./n. 指控；收费；充电；费用
entries.definitionEn: To formally accuse someone, ask a price, or supply electrical energy.
entries.scenario: 指控义常为正式指控；其他常用义包括收费和充电

examples.en: He was charged with theft.

entries.definitionEn: To bring a legal claim against a person or organization.
entries.scenario: 强调向法院提起诉讼，常见于索赔等民事语境

examples.en: She sued the company for damages.
examples.zh: 她起诉该公司要求赔偿。

entries.definitionEn: To say that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
entries.scenario: 可用于日常指责或法律语境，本身不表示已正式起诉

examples.en: They accused him of lying.

groups.selectionNote: accuse sb of doing 是指责某人做了某事；charge sb with sth 常表示正式指控；sue sb for sth 是提起诉讼或要求赔偿。指控不等于定罪。三者句型不同，不要写 accuse sb for 或 charge sb of。

entries.definitionEn: To cover something by folding material around it; also a loose outer covering or garment.
entries.scenario: 动词强调用材料包住；名词可泛指披肩等裹身衣物

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.

entries.meaningZh: n. 长披肩；v. steal 的过去式
entries.definitionEn: A long narrow scarf worn over the shoulders; also the past tense of steal.
entries.scenario: 名词常指搭在肩上的长条披肩；动词形式表示偷了

examples.en: She wore a silk stole over her dress.
examples.zh: 她在连衣裙外披了一条丝绸长披肩。

groups.selectionNote: wrap 作动词表示包裹，也可作名词表示披肩；stole 作名词是长条披肩，比 wrap 更具体。stole 还可能是 steal 的过去式：Someone stole my bag.（有人偷了我的包。）

entries.definitionEn: To remove something unwanted or exclude someone from further consideration or competition.
entries.scenario: 侧重去掉问题、可能性或比赛对手，使其不再起作用

examples.en: We need to eliminate unnecessary costs.
examples.zh: 我们需要削减不必要的开支。

entries.definitionEn: To remove written text or stored computer data.
entries.scenario: 侧重删除文字、文件或数据，不保证数据无法恢复

examples.en: I deleted the duplicate file.

groups.selectionNote: eliminate 常用于消除错误、排除可能性和淘汰选手；delete 常用于删除文字或电子数据。删除一条错误信息可用 delete，消除系统性错误常用 eliminate；两者有重叠但不能处处互换。

entries.definitionEn: A storage cupboard, often with doors or drawers; also a group of senior government ministers.
entries.scenario: 常指有门、可带抽屉的储物柜；政治义指内阁

examples.en: The plates are in the kitchen cabinet.

entries.definitionEn: A cupboard or small enclosed space used especially for storing clothes.
entries.scenario: 美式常指嵌入式储物空间或放衣服的小空间；英式常用 wardrobe 表示衣橱

examples.en: She hung her coat in the closet.

groups.selectionNote: cabinet 常指储物柜，不限于衣物；closet 在美式英语中常指壁橱或放衣服的储物空间。cabinet 另有内阁义；closet 不要求一定能走进去，能步入的叫 walk-in closet。

entries.definitionEn: To feel a very strong desire for something.
entries.scenario: 表达强烈欲望，常用于食物、关注、认可；通常直接接宾语

examples.en: I often crave chocolate after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我常常特别想吃巧克力。

entries.definitionEn: To want something, or a strong wish to have or do something.
entries.scenario: 含义较宽，作动词往往比 want 正式；可接名词或不定式

examples.en: She has a strong desire to learn.

groups.selectionNote: crave 比一般的 desire 更强调强烈、迫切的欲望；desire 范围较广且作动词较正式。通常说 crave something，不必加 for；名词 craving 可用 a craving for。desire to do 表示渴望做某事。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 芯片；碎片；缺口；薯条／薯片；筹码；使崩缺
entries.definitionEn: A small electronic component, a small broken piece or mark, a snack, or a gaming token; as a verb, to break off a small piece.
entries.scenario: 按语境辨义：英式 chips 常指薯条，美式 chips 常指薄脆薯片

examples.en: This phone uses a powerful chip.
examples.zh: 这部手机使用了一枚性能强大的芯片。

groups.selectionNote: chip 常见义：a computer chip 芯片；wood chips 木屑；a chip in a cup 杯沿缺口；poker chips 扑克筹码。英式 fish and chips 中 chips 是薯条；美式 potato chips 通常是薯片，英式常称 crisps。chip in 可指凑钱或插话：We each chipped in five pounds.（我们每人凑了五英镑。）动词例：I chipped the plate.（我把盘子磕出了缺口。）

entries.definitionEn: To express what you honestly think in a direct way.
entries.scenario: 强调诚实直接地说出真实想法

examples.en: To be frank, I disagree with the plan.
examples.zh: 坦率地说，我不同意这个计划。

entries.definitionEn: Expressing opinions openly and strongly.
entries.scenario: 强调公开而大胆地表达意见，尤其批评

examples.en: She is outspoken about unfair treatment.
examples.zh: 她对不公平待遇直言不讳。

groups.selectionNote: 两者都可表示坦率。frank 强调诚实直接；outspoken 更强调公开、大胆地表达立场，不必然粗鲁。to be frank 常作插入语。

entries.definitionEn: To push or fold something into a small space or secure position.
entries.scenario: 常把松散部分塞到另一物下面或里面

examples.en: He tucked his shirt into his trousers.
examples.zh: 他把衬衫下摆塞进裤子里。

groups.selectionNote: tuck sth into sth 表示塞入或掖入；tuck a child in 是给孩子掖好被子；tuck away 可指藏好、收存。英式口语 tuck in 还可指开始大吃：Tuck in!（开吃吧！）

entries.definitionEn: To examine closely or ask searching questions; an instrument used to explore.
entries.scenario: 强调深入探问、试探或用仪器检查

examples.en: The reporter probed into the reasons for the delay.
examples.zh: 记者深入追问延误的原因。

entries.definitionEn: To examine facts systematically to discover the truth or cause.
entries.scenario: 范围较广，强调系统查明事实或原因

examples.en: The team investigated the cause of the failure.
examples.zh: 团队调查了失败的原因。

groups.selectionNote: probe 常带深入、试探性的意味，也可指医学探查或太空探测器；investigate 是调查的通用动词。两者都可及物，也都能接 into；不能把区别绝对化为非正式与正式。

entries.meaningZh: v./n. 啪地折断；猛地合上；厉声说；快照
entries.definitionEn: To break or move suddenly with a sharp sound, speak sharply, or take a quick photograph.
entries.scenario: 常带突然、快速、清脆的感觉

examples.en: The branch snapped in the wind.
examples.zh: 树枝在风中啪地折断了。

groups.selectionNote: snap at sb 是对某人厉声说话；snap a photo 是快速拍照；snap one's fingers 是打响指；a snap decision 是仓促作出的决定。The dog snapped at my hand. 表示狗突然朝我的手咬去，不说明已经咬中。

entries.meaningZh: v./n. 激起好奇；密谋；阴谋活动
entries.definitionEn: To arouse curiosity; secret planning to gain power or advantage.
entries.scenario: 动词最常见于引起兴趣或好奇；名词也指秘密谋划

examples.en: The unusual title intrigued me.
examples.zh: 这个不寻常的标题激起了我的好奇心。

entries.meaningZh: n./v. 情节；阴谋；地块；密谋；绘图
entries.definitionEn: The events of a story, a secret plan, or a piece of land; to plan secretly or mark data on a graph.
entries.scenario: 故事结构、具体阴谋或筹划行为，含义取决于语境

examples.en: The novel has a complicated plot.
examples.zh: 这部小说的情节很复杂。

groups.selectionNote: 表示阴谋时，intrigue 常侧重秘密运作和权力斗争，plot 常指具体计划。intrigue sb 通常是让某人好奇；plot a graph 是绘制图表；不要把两词所有含义都视为近义。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 脆的；清新的；清晰利落的
entries.definitionEn: Firm and pleasantly brittle, or fresh, clear and precise.
entries.scenario: 可形容食物，也可形容空气、声音、图像或动作

examples.en: The lettuce is fresh and crisp.

entries.definitionEn: Having a pleasantly hard, brittle texture, especially when cooked.
entries.scenario: 主要形容食物表面或质地，常用于油炸或烘烤食品

examples.en: Bake until the skin is crispy.

groups.selectionNote: 食物语境可有重叠：crisp bacon 和 crispy bacon 都自然。crisp 的适用范围更广；清新的空气用 crisp air，一般不用 crispy air。英式 crisps 是薯片。

entries.meaningZh: v. 设法做到；谋划；设计
entries.definitionEn: To manage to do something through effort or ingenuity, or devise a plan.
entries.scenario: 常暗示费心安排或用巧思达成，也可能带刻意感

examples.en: She contrived to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 她设法按时完成了工作。

groups.selectionNote: contrive to do 常表示费了心思终于做到，也可讽刺竟然做成坏事。contrived 作形容词常指刻意的、不自然的：a contrived ending（牵强的结局）。

entries.meaningZh: adj./n. 立即的；即食的；瞬间
entries.definitionEn: Immediate or prepared quickly; a very short moment of time.
entries.scenario: 形容反应、食品等，也可作可数名词

examples.en: She gave an instant reply.

entries.meaningZh: adj. 瞬时的；即刻发生的
entries.definitionEn: Happening immediately or taking an extremely short time.
entries.scenario: 强调几乎不耗时，常用于科学、技术或正式描述

examples.en: The device measures instantaneous speed.

groups.selectionNote: instant 较日常，instantaneous 较正式，两者在立即发生义上有重叠。即溶咖啡固定说 instant coffee。an instant 是一瞬间；instantaneous 没有这个名词用法。

entries.definitionEn: To value someone or show consideration for rights, wishes or rules.
entries.scenario: 可指认可某人的品质，也可指尊重权利、意愿或规则

examples.en: We should respect other people's privacy.
examples.zh: 我们应尊重他人的隐私。

entries.definitionEn: To regard someone or something highly; great respect.
entries.scenario: 偏正式，常因品质或成就而高度评价

examples.en: Her colleagues hold her in high esteem.

groups.selectionNote: respect 范围更广：respect a decision 是尊重决定，不一定赞同。esteem 强调高度评价且较正式；hold sb in high esteem 很常见。self-esteem 是自尊、自我价值感。

entries.meaningZh: adj./n. 必不可少的；整体组成的；积分
entries.definitionEn: Necessary as a constituent part of a whole; in mathematics, an integral.
entries.scenario: 形容词强调构成整体不可缺的一部分；名词为数学术语

examples.en: Reading is an integral part of language learning.
examples.zh: 阅读是语言学习不可缺少的一部分。

entries.meaningZh: adj. 至关重要的；维持生命必需的
entries.definitionEn: Extremely important or necessary for life or success.
entries.scenario: 强调对生存、成功或正常运作的必要性

examples.en: Water is vital for survival.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely important because it can determine the result.
entries.scenario: 强调对结果或关键阶段有决定作用

examples.en: This evidence is crucial to the investigation.
examples.zh: 这项证据对调查至关重要。

groups.selectionNote: integral 关注整体与组成部分的关系，常用 an integral part of；vital 关注必需性；crucial 关注决定结果的关键作用。三者有重叠，不能固定为强弱等级。integral 作名词还表示积分。

entries.meaningZh: adj./v./n. 齐平的；冲洗；脸红；红晕
entries.definitionEn: Level with an adjoining surface; to rinse with flowing water or become red in the face.
entries.scenario: 齐平义强调两个表面贴合并处在同一平面

examples.en: The door is flush with the wall.

entries.meaningZh: adj./v./n. 水平的；同高的；使平整；水平或级别
entries.definitionEn: Horizontal, flat or at the same height; a degree or stage; to make flat.
entries.scenario: 范围更广，可指水平、同高、程度或等级

examples.en: The shelf is level with the window.
examples.zh: 架子与窗户处于同一高度。

groups.selectionNote: flush with 强调相接表面不凸出也不凹入；level with 常表示高度相同，不要求接触。地面水平可说 level；不能一概用 flush 替换。flush 还有冲洗、脸红和扑克牌同花等义。

entries.definitionEn: To begin, especially in a formal context.
entries.scenario: 较正式，常见于公告、仪式或正式活动

examples.en: The ceremony will commence at ten.

entries.definitionEn: To begin an activity or cause something to begin or operate.
entries.scenario: 日常最通用，也可指启动机器或突然惊动

examples.en: Please start the engine.

groups.selectionNote: 普通对话通常用 start；commence 更正式，但不代表事情规模一定更大。commence doing 与 commence with 常见；启动发动机用 start the engine。start a business 是创业。

entries.definitionEn: To look at someone or something for a long time with your eyes wide open.
entries.scenario: 强调长时间直视，可能因惊讶、好奇或出神；不一定带恶意

examples.en: He stared at the strange object.
examples.zh: 他盯着那个奇怪的物体看。

entries.definitionEn: To look steadily at someone or something, often with admiration or thought.
entries.scenario: 强调持续、专注地看，常带欣赏、思考或柔和的感情色彩

examples.en: She gazed at the stars.

entries.definitionEn: To look angrily at someone; also, a very bright and uncomfortable light.
entries.scenario: 看人的动词义强调愤怒；名词也可指强烈刺眼的光

examples.en: He glared at me without saying a word.
examples.zh: 他一言不发地怒视着我。

entries.meaningZh: v./n. 费力细看；同龄人；同等地位者
entries.definitionEn: To look carefully or with difficulty; as a noun, a person of similar age or status.
entries.scenario: 动词强调因昏暗、距离或遮挡而努力看清；名词是另一常见用法

examples.en: She peered through the window into the dark room.
examples.zh: 她透过窗户仔细看那间昏暗的房间。

groups.selectionNote: stare 是盯着看；gaze 常是凝望；glare at 表示怒视；peer 强调努力看清。四词都可接 at，但感情色彩和观看方式不同。不要把 stare 一概理解成不礼貌，也不要把 gaze 限定为爱慕。peer 作名词可指同龄人或同等地位者；glare 作名词还可指刺眼的光。

entries.definitionEn: To combine separate amounts into a total; also, a total or relating to that total.
entries.scenario: 强调把若干项合并成整体，或指合计结果；常用于数据与经济语境

examples.en: The report aggregates sales data from all regions.
examples.zh: 这份报告汇总了所有地区的销售数据。

entries.definitionEn: To put parts together or bring people together in one place.
entries.scenario: 强调把零件组装起来，或让人聚集在一处

examples.en: We assembled the desk in an hour.
examples.zh: 我们用一小时组装好了书桌。

entries.definitionEn: To increase or collect gradually over time.
entries.scenario: 强调数量随着时间或反复增加，不要求有人刻意收集

examples.en: Dust accumulated on the shelves.

groups.selectionNote: aggregate 侧重汇总后的整体或总量；assemble 侧重把零件组装或把人召集起来；accumulate 侧重随时间逐渐积累。数据既可以先积累再汇总，但这些动词关注的过程不同。aggregate 作形容词可说 aggregate demand。

entries.definitionEn: A stated reason used to hide the real reason for doing something.
entries.scenario: 通常暗示公开给出的理由并非真实动机

examples.en: He left early on the pretext of feeling ill.
examples.zh: 他以身体不适为由提前离开了。

entries.definitionEn: A reason offered to explain or justify something; also, to forgive or pardon.
entries.scenario: 泛指解释或开脱的理由，不必然是假的；也可作动词

examples.en: She had a good excuse for being late: her train was cancelled.
examples.zh: 她迟到有正当理由：火车停运了。

groups.selectionNote: pretext 通常暗示所说的理由是托词，真实动机另有所在；excuse 是更宽泛的理由或辩解，也可能完全正当。excuse 作动词还表示原谅。on the pretext of doing 是常见句型；不能从 excuse 一词本身断定说话者撒谎。

words.definitionEn: To put something inside or between other things.
words.scenario: 强调把东西放进内部或间隙

examples.en: Insert the card into the slot.

words.correctUsage: Insert the card into the slot.
words.commonMistakes: 要强调“放进去”用 insert；强调“插电或堵洞”用 plug。plug it in 中代词放在动词与 in 之间。

words.definitionEn: To connect a device to a socket, or fill a hole.
words.scenario: 强调接通设备，或封住孔洞

examples.en: Plug the cable into the socket.

words.correctUsage: Plug the cable into the socket.
